01

Specialism

The artists’ regime leaves no room for improvisation.

Day-by-day engagements, frequent registrations and deregistrations, specific contributions, shifting production schedules and different collective agreements. We understand that reality because we have worked inside it for 26 years.

We coordinate with production, administration and management so employment processes support the project instead of slowing it down.
